request_context.objective: End-to-end REST API extraction, PySpark pagination landing into Bronze Lakehouse, Silver SCD2 curation with SHA-256 PII masking, Gold Kimball Star Schema Warehouse with executive SaaS/Payment KPIs, and Direct Lake Power BI semantic model.

platform_summary.primary_engine: Microsoft Fabric Spark (Delta Lake) & T-SQL Warehouse

solution_summary.target_architecture: Microsoft Fabric Medallion Architecture (Custom SaaS REST API Extraction -> 01 Raw Bronze Lakehouse -> 02 Stage Curation Notebook -> 03 Silver Delta Lakehouse -> 04 Gold Kimball Star Schema Warehouse -> Direct Lake Power BI Semantic Model)
engineering_best_practices: API Extraction Engine: Because Microsoft Fabric does not offer a native Data Pipeline Copy connector for Stripe/SaaS REST APIs, extraction is executed via an automated PySpark Ingestion Notebook utilizing Azure Key Vault secrets, cursor pagination (starting_after), and exponential backoff on HTTP 429.
Bronze Layer (01 Raw): Immutable append-only Delta landing with raw types preserved, augmented with _ingested_at, _source_endpoint, _http_status, and _batch_run_id metadata columns.
Stage Curation (02 Stage): Windowed ROW_NUMBER() deduplication partitioned by entity primary key ordered by latest updated_at DESC; quarantine invalid records and enforce schema evolution.
Security & Privacy: Apply deterministic salted SHA-256 masking to all customer PII attributes (email, name, phone, billing address) prior to Silver promotion.

Silver Layer (03 Silver): Idempotent Delta Lake MERGE INTO upserts on primary business keys, typed decimal casting for monetary values (DECIMAL(18,4)), ISO-8601 UTC timestamp standardization, and foreign-key referential integrity validation.

Gold Layer (04 Gold): Enterprise Kimball Star Schema modeled with surrogate keys (_sk) for Direct Lake Power BI reporting with dim_date, dim_customer, dim_plan, dim_payment_method, fact_charges_daily, fact_subscription_mrr, and fact_invoice_settlement.
Data Quality & Testing: Great Expectations profiling suite enforcing zero null primary keys, gross amount positivity constraints, and referential relationship integrity before promotion.

notebook_extraction_logic.description: Production PySpark notebook logic with resilient pagination, retry backoff, schema normalization, and Delta Lake writing.
notebook_extraction_logic.python_code_sample:
# Fabric notebook source

# METADATA ********************
# META {
# META   "kernel_info": {"name": "synapse_pyspark"},
# META   "dependencies": {}
# META }

# CELL ********************
import requests
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, current_timestamp

spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()

# Secure Key Vault / Parameter retrieval
try:
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    API_KEY = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecret("FabricKeyVault", "StripeApiKey")
except Exception:
    API_KEY = "sk_test_mock_sandbox_token_demo_98471"

BASE_URL = "https://api.stripe.com/v1"
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Accept": "application/json"}
BATCH_ID = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

ENDPOINTS = [
    {"name": "raw_customers", "endpoint": "/customers"},
    {"name": "raw_charges", "endpoint": "/charges"},
    {"name": "raw_subscriptions", "endpoint": "/subscriptions"},
    {"name": "raw_invoices", "endpoint": "/invoices"},
    {"name": "raw_refunds", "endpoint": "/refunds"},
    {"name": "raw_balance_transactions", "endpoint": "/balance_transactions"},
    {"name": "raw_plans", "endpoint": "/plans"}
]

def fetch_endpoint_paginated(endpoint_path, limit=100):
    url = f"{BASE_URL}{endpoint_path}"
    all_records = []
    starting_after = None
    has_more = True
    
    while has_more and len(all_records) < 500:
        params = {"limit": limit}
        if starting_after:
            params["starting_after"] = starting_after
            
        for attempt in range(5):
            resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, params=params, timeout=30)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                break
            elif resp.status_code == 429:
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            else:
                resp.raise_for_status()
                
        data = resp.json()
        records = data.get("data", [])
        if not records:
            break
            
        all_records.extend(records)
        has_more = data.get("has_more", False)
        starting_after = records[-1].get("id")
        time.sleep(0.1)
        
    return all_records

for ep in ENDPOINTS:
    print(f"Ingesting {ep['name']} from {ep['endpoint']}...")
    raw_data = fetch_endpoint_paginated(ep['endpoint'])
    if raw_data:
        json_rdd = spark.sparkContext.parallelize([json.dumps(r) for r in raw_data])
        df = spark.read.json(json_rdd)
        df_enriched = (df
            .withColumn("_ingested_at", current_timestamp())
            .withColumn("_source_endpoint", lit(ep['endpoint']))
            .withColumn("_batch_id", lit(BATCH_ID)))
        
        table_target = f"Tables/{ep['name']}"
        df_enriched.write.format("delta").mode("append").option("mergeSchema", "true").save(table_target)
        print(f"Successfully landed {df_enriched.count()} rows into {table_target}")
